protocol.prior_series: First formal run stopped after a controller variable shadowed the analysis module; native target completed and all raw data retained, no frame data changed. Corrected controller starts a complete new sequence. New independently rebuilt workspace binary, public endpoint CPU and enclosing process RUSAGE_INFO_V6 counters; this is a separate instrumented diagnostic population

arms.B: same relay launched via LaunchServices; posix_spawn target identical

protocol.population: opt-in CPU16/wall samples; separate from default and trace populations
protocol.analysis: per-process quantile, per-group B mean minus A mean; median of five paired group deltas; no frame independence or source-cause claim
protocol.slow_scope: CPU threshold only, no physical CPU/TG classification
protocol.native_scope: public PID/TID and task-role endpoint snapshots only; interior TG tenure and coalition unknown
protocol.load_policy: no own compilation or other GPU test during run; observe load/processes before and after each run; other user processes are uncontrolled, retained rather than filtered
protocol.failure_policy: retain every attempt; stop on invalid exit/config/work/identity/hash; no replacement or prefix fitting
protocol.counter_scope: Public process-wide counter snapshots enclose each CPU16 sample. Other-thread P/non-P time only weakens the sufficient main-thread 95% lower bound; not TG tenure or main-thread instruction counts.
protocol.observer_scope: Public getters outside CPU16 interval can affect placement; these are not default timing data.

independent_review.language: Ruby Rational + Python Fraction, independently expressed inequalities
independent_review.scope: Two independently expressed calculation paths on the same observations, not an independent human or agent review.

scope: Diagnostic population; same frozen binary, target environment/cwd/workload; route intervention is not a source-code A/B. Counter instructions include all process threads.
postprocessing: Aggregate exact-rational CPU-time bounds, cadence summaries and public derivatives added after the frozen v1 frame classifier; no measured row removed or reassigned.

surface.scope: explicit host-thread query after the first direct presentation; configured Surface values, not measured scanout cadence

painter.scope: measured real Window Scene painter encodes from Runtime WorkCounters; setup and warmup excluded; GPU buffer reallocations are not process malloc
